data.name: Constancia
data.gender_notes: Constancia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘constans’, meaning steadfast, firm, or unwavering. In Christianity, Constancia represents the virtue of steadfastness, remaining loyal and faithful despite challenges or trials. The name Constancia carries the meaning “Steadfastness, firmness, constancy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Constancia usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfastness, firmness, constancy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unwavering faith and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Constancia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfastness, firmness, constancy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Constancia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: קוֹסְטַנְצִיָּה
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נשים העולה על מועדון האומץ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קוֹסְטַנְצִיָּה, הנגזרת מהמילים היווניות 'קוֹסְטְאָנְטִי' (קוראג' - גבורה) ו-'נְצִיָּה' (ניצחון), מראה על אדם חזק שקוראג' לסבל ולהתקדמות. בנוסף, זהו שם נשים נדיר, שבו נשים יכולות להיראות חזקות ועצמאיות.

in_greek.name: Κωνστάντια
in_greek.long_meaning: Κωνστάντια, הנגזרת מהמילים 'κωνστάντιος' (κοράγιος - קוראג') ו-'νίκη' (ניצחון), מייצגת אדם שחוזק בקוראג' ובניצחון. במסורת הנוצרית, קוראג' מיוחס לאדם שהוא חזק ומסוגל לעמוד במאבקים.

in_latin.name: Constancia
in_latin.long_meaning: Constancia, nomen femininum fortitudo et victoria demonstrans. Derivatur ab verbis 'constans,' quod significat 'fortis' et 'firmus,' et 'tia,' quod est suffixum femininum. In historia ecclesiae, nomen huiusmodi monstrat virtutem et perseverantiam in fide Christi.

in_english.name: Constancia
in_english.meaning: a feminine given name that signifies courage and victory
in_english.long_meaning: Constancia is a rare given name that originates from the Greek words 'kostantia' (courage) and 'nike' (victory). It is a name that signifies strength and perseverance in the face of challenges. In Christian tradition, courage is associated with the ability to stand firm in one's faith and overcome obstacles. This name is a powerful reminder of the importance of courage and determination in our spiritual journey.

In these communities, Constancia is revered as a symbol of strength, determination, and loyalty. It is a popular name for both girls and women who are viewed as beacons of perseverance and stability.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Constancia holds exceptional meaning for Christians. It embodies the virtues of faith, hope, and trust in God. Regarded as a reminder to stand firm in our beliefs, no matter the circumstances, the name inspires us to stay strong when faced with adversity or difficulties.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Constancia: Firmness in faith and unwavering commitment to God. Echoes of the Biblical figure who remained steadfast in her belief despite persecution.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Constancia was a Christian martyr in the 4th century. The name Constancia carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Constancia was a Roman noblewoman who was executed for her refusal to marry a pagan man and abandon her Christian faith.
